---
title: Work with published releases of data from the  Homer Multitext project
---

## Overview

- a personal collection of "two-coffee" web apps
- all apps can be run from a web server or from a single local file
- apps dynamically load the HMT project's latest published release
- explore HMT datasets starting text passages, physical artifact, or documentary image
- throughout all apps, display of text passages formats edited content by manuscript page
